steps: Sign up free at tester.userbrain.com and install the Userbrain Recorder (Chrome, iOS, or Android)
Record the unpaid qualification test and get approved as a tester
Receive paid test invitations matched to your device and language
Complete TWO tests: think aloud through the tasks for 5–20 minutes each and upload the videos
Get $5 credited per approved video (approval at Userbrain's sole discretion); reach the $10 balance
Request payout to PayPal from your dashboard — generally credited within one week
timing: Payout requested from the dashboard once the balance reaches $10 (two approved tests); Userbrain's terms say a requested payout 'will generally be credited to the User's account within one week.' PayPal only.
who_pays: Userbrain pays you — a flat $5 for every approved test video, sent to your PayPal.
who_qualifies: 18+, one account per person, fluent English, reliable internet, and a computer, smartphone, or tablet. You must pass an unpaid qualification test before you get any paid tests.
work_available: Irregular and not guaranteed. Paid test invites depend on your quality ratings, device, language, and current client demand — volume is uneven, so treat it as intermittent extra cash, not a schedule.
what_gets_accepted: A test only pays if it's approved — approval is at Userbrain's sole discretion, and rejected tests pay nothing. Your first videos set your quality bar, so think aloud nonstop with clean audio on every test. Never share test content: the terms carry a $5,000 penalty for disclosing confidential test material.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join — no fee. Your unpaid time: the qualification test and the wait for invites. And your first payout is delayed: you must reach a $10 balance (two approved $5 tests) before you can request anything.
when_cash_arrives: Request a payout from your dashboard once your balance hits $10 (two approved tests). Per Userbrain's official terms, a requested payout is generally credited to your PayPal account within one week. PayPal only.
